title: The Cutting EDG: March 22nd, 2021
body:
## **Tech**

- The Tokyo Upgrade has passed, [bringing EVM functionality to Edgeware and opening a world of development, dapps, tooling, and infrastructure.](https://blog.edgewa.re/evm-launch-on-edgeware-brings-wealth-of-ethereum-contracts-and-developers-to-substrate/)
- The technology for opening a bridge to ETH has been installed as well, called Chainbridge, built by the ChainSafe team.
- Governance parameters have been altered to allow the chain to make more decisions over time.
- Thom Ivy opens a discussion on a different technical path being a DOT parachain by launching [a bridge to DOT_ as a parachain_ for the Edgeware network.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1095-multichain-edgeware-a-new-path-to-dot)


## **Ecosystem Updates**

**Commonwealth.im**
_The multi-chain governance and community interface._
The Commonwealth team is making progress on an MVP for the new Commonwealth Protocol, more to come in the next two weeks. To build a new marketing site and mobile experience, they’ve also added more developers. 
** **
**DTrade**
_DTrade is a platform for trading perpetuals and options on Edgeware._
No major updates this week, just building.
** **
**Decent Partners**
_Decent is a 'metadao' that seeks to create crypto-native public media._
Decent [shared their recent progress in crafting their offer](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/831-decent-an-edgeware-ecosystem-project-update-150321) to Edgeware users in return for an upcoming treasury proposal to fund digital arts and media assets in the public's interest.
** **
**LexBridge**
_Lexbridge is a technological bridge to jurisdictions in the US - launch a DAO, and get a Series LLC mapped to that DAO._
